model.label: Two parallel public subsystems: the Ministry of Health (tax-funded, covers everyone in practice) and the Social Security Fund CSS (payroll-funded, for formal workers and dependants), with a small voluntary private sector

overview.statement: The World Bank's 2024 primary care review describes a centralised system in which health decisions, stewardship and resource management sit mainly at national level. It is split between two public institutions, the Ministry of Health (MINSA) and the Social Security Fund (CSS), with a private sector alongside.
